stories.title: Musk says any limits on Ukraine's Starlink access down to US, not his firm
stories.body: Ukraine says Starlink access has improved but it is still facing speed limits which are disrupting its battlefield "missions".

stories.title: Student protesters attack government buildings in Tirana
stories.body: Thousands of students in Albania are calling for better university conditions and job prospects, but buildings have been set on fire in the unrest.

stories.title: Pope walking and recovering 'as expected' after surgery, doctors say
stories.body: The 71-year-old Pope was diagnosed with lung cancer after the 90-minute procedure on Tuesday.

stories.title: US inflation rises more than expected - here's what is happening with prices
stories.body: The pace of price rises increased to 3.7% in the year to September, driving by higher motor fuel costs.

stories.title: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
stories.body: Four years after the attacks, Serhii Kuznetsov appears in court accused of a plot to destroy Russia's gas pipelines to Germany.

stories.title: Australia's first-ever Michelin stars go to 11 restaurants in one state
stories.body: All of the spots are in South Australia, reportedly because the state government paid for incognito inspectors to visit.

stories.title: Kenya confirms second Ebola case - a relative of the first victim
stories.body: It follows the death last week of a man who had arrived in Kenya after travelling from DR Congo.

stories.title: Netflix to shed 1,000 jobs in steepest cuts since 2022
stories.body: The cuts equate to around 6% of the streaming giant's total workforce worldwide.

stories.title: Hundreds of thousands of workers on strike across Republic of Ireland
stories.body: It comes amidst an an ongoing pay dispute between public sector workers and the Irish government.

stories.title: Container ship hit by projectile sinks in Strait of Hormuz, Singapore says
stories.body: All 21 sailors on the Singapore-flagged GFS Pride were evacuated safely after it was hit by an projectile on Tuesday, maritime authorities say.

stories.title: Turkish police raid opposition TV station, halting live broadcasts
stories.body: It is the latest in a series of crackdowns on media critical of the Turkish president and his government.

stories.title: World's oldest shipwreck found off coast of Turkey
stories.body: Archaeologists say the wreck is up to 4,700 years old, dating to the Early Bronze Age.

stories.title: Mauritius reels from worst riots in decades after woman shot by police
stories.body: Prime Minister Navin Ramgoolam imposed a curfew after days of unrest that first began over water shortages.

stories.title: Saudi employee charged with planting recording device in OpenAI office
stories.body: Prosecutors say the device, wrapped in toilet paper, was found inserted in a USB port on the back of a TV in an executive conference room.

stories.title: Burnham says he wants to 'repair bridges' between Ukraine and US
stories.body: It comes as the prime minister meets President Zelensky at Downing Street.

stories.title: Why is Starlink internet so important on the battlefield in Ukraine?
stories.body: It is the "backbone of military communications in Ukraine" that provides vital high-speed internet to forces across the country.

stories.title: Toilet paper and secret recorders: What we know about the arrest of the Saudi OpenAI engineer
stories.body: Abdulrahman Alfozan had worked for the AI giant for more than a year before he was arrested by the FBI.

stories.title: Are the European Women's World Cup play-offs working?
stories.body: The ease in which England saw off Greece in round one of the Women's World Cup qualifying play-offs showed just how inefficient the structure currently is.

stories.title: Pictured: Winning entries for Wildlife Photographer of the Year 2026
stories.body: Striking images including an urban coyote and an elephant carrying a dead calf are among this year's winners.

stories.title: 'I'd talk to the TV': The paid companions bringing warmth to China's lonely
stories.body: As loneliness grows in China, a new industry is emerging to provide companionship and support.
